title.zh: v1.16.15 修复调音台未播放即满格的假电平，通道控件补到 44px
title.en: v1.16.15 Fixed phantom full-scale console meters and enlarged channel controls to 44px

highlights.zh: 修复真实缺陷：AudioContext 挂起时（首次交互前）WebAudio 返回全 0 帧，而字节时域缓冲以 128 为零线，全 0 被读成 0 dBFS——刚打开页面什么都没播放，所有通道表却顶在红区。现在完全平坦的缓冲一律视为静音（母带表此前也有同样问题）
highlights.en: Fixed a real defect: while the AudioContext is suspended (before the first interaction) WebAudio returns all-zero frames, and since byte time-domain buffers are centred on 128, those read as 0 dBFS — every channel meter sat in the red on load with nothing playing. Flat buffers are now treated as silence (the master meter had the same latent issue)

highlights.zh: 调音台的 M/S/Ø 控件从 28px 提升到 44×44px，通道条相应加宽；目标设备（iPad / 横屏平板）是触摸屏，28px 控件实测难以点中
highlights.en: Console M/S/Ø controls grew from 28px to 44×44px with wider channel strips; the target devices (iPad / landscape tablets) are touch screens where 28px targets are genuinely hard to hit

highlights.zh: 实测：静止 0.0% → 播放 99.9%，电平表由真实信号驱动；触摸目标 26×28px → 44×44px
highlights.en: Measured: meter travel 0.0% idle → 99.9% playing, driven by the real signal; touch targets 26×28px → 44×44px
